sermon.title: How To Become A Pastor, Minister, or Teacher for Jesus Christ
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: From Mark 3–6 Pastor David G. Kincer lays out Jesus’ processing plan for ministry: follow him, respond to his call, be with him, be taught and shown his authority, and only then be sent to preach repentance. Drawing on his own experience, he explains the problems with personal prophecy and the more excellent way of love, and urges all believers to seek wisdom.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Delivered as a teaching session (he mentions a timekeeper); speaker is Pastor Kincer (he refers to himself as Dave Kincer). Two phrases not clear (44:20, 59:30). He cites “James 1:15” for asking wisdom (James 1:5) and calls Jairus’s daughter a “noble man’s child.” His Micah 4 paraphrase is garbled (swords into pruning hooks). Personal anecdotes (Africa crowds healed, China churches, a failed personal prophecy) are his own. Sensitive content kept as spoken: seminaries as factories, Pentecostal teaching on tongues and authority, Catholic ritual worship, evolution, Obama/Democrats/Republicans.

faqs.question: What is the first requirement to be used in the kingdom?
faqs.answer: Follow Jesus—take accountability and responsibility to respond when he comes.

faqs.question: Can you go through Christ’s processing plan at home?
faqs.answer: He says no—it is in his church, the gathering together of his people.

faqs.question: Why are many Christians fruitless?
faqs.answer: They haven’t answered the call to be with him; they want action before processing.

faqs.question: How much time should you spend with Jesus?
faqs.answer: He points to Jesus asking for one hour out of 24.

faqs.question: Is healing the sick for today?
faqs.answer: Yes—it is always in God’s dispensation; he cares for his people’s physical, spiritual, mental and emotional condition.

faqs.question: Is it wrong to write in your Bible?
faqs.answer: No—write down what God teaches you or you will forget it.

faqs.question: Can the office of a prophet miss?
faqs.answer: No—he says if they miss the Bible calls them a false prophet.

faqs.question: Must everyone speak in tongues?
faqs.answer: No—all don’t speak in tongues or interpret; tongues is Bible and a sign for the unbeliever.

faqs.question: What should you say instead of praising a preacher?
faqs.answer: “Thank you for letting God use you”—don’t worship men.

faqs.question: Has God given up on America?
faqs.answer: He says no—God has faithful people here and can change America back.
